title: Bridging Search Intent and Tabular Data in Dataset Search
abstract: arXiv:2610.33936v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Dataset search remains a bottleneck in data analysis workflows, as existing systems largely rely on keyword matching or shallow retrieval that fail to capture user intent. To facilitate intent-driven search, we present two retrieval components to equip multi-faceted dataset search interfaces through natural language. First, we propose Hypothetical Schema Embeddings (HySE) that uses a language model to generate task-aligned hypothetical table schemas which are used for embedding-based retrieval, bridging the gap between intent and table content. We introduce KaggleDS, a corpus comprising 6,503 tables and diverse task-queries derived from Kaggle, and show that HySE consistently improves recall over strong keyword and embedding-based baselines, as well as over a dense table retriever fine-tuned on KaggleDS. translated_title: 弥合数据集搜索中搜索意图与表格数据之间的鸿沟
translated_abstract: 数据集搜索仍然是数据分析工作流程中的一个瓶颈，因为现有系统主要依赖关键词匹配或浅层检索，无法捕捉用户意图。为了促进基于意图的搜索，我们提出了两个检索组件，通过自然语言为多方面的数据集搜索界面提供支持。首先，我们提出了假设模式嵌入，它利用语言模型生成与任务对齐的假设表格模式，并将其用于基于嵌入的检索，从而弥合了用户意图与表格内容之间的差距。我们构建了KaggleDS语料库，其中包含6,503个表格以及源自Kaggle的多样化任务查询，实验表明HySE在召回率上持续优于强大的关键词基线、基于嵌入的基线，以及在KaggleDS上微调的密集表格检索器。我们还证明了HySE能够泛化到端到端问答任务，例如在NQ-Tables数据集（一个包含169,898个维基百科表格的语料库）上的应用。
tldr: 提出假设模式嵌入方法，利用语言模型生成任务对齐的假设表格模式进行嵌入检索，有效弥合了数据集搜索中用户意图与表格内容之间的鸿沟，并构建了KaggleDS语料库验证其在召回率上优于现有基线方法。
en_tdlr: Proposes Hypothetical Schema Embeddings (HySE), which leverages a language model to generate task-aligned hypothetical table schemas for embedding-based retrieval, bridging the gap between user intent and table content in dataset search, and introduces the KaggleDS corpus demonstrating consistent recall improvements over existing baselines.
